ValidationRule.description: The AE and SDM approved boxes need to be checked for the invoice status to equal Reviewed by AE/SDM.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c, "Reviewed by AE/SDM") && OR(AE_Approved__c = false, SDM_Approved__c = false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To set the status to Reviewed by AE/SDM the AE and SDM must check off that they have approved.
